Legal Information

Privacy & Complaints

Our commitment to protecting your data and maintaining the highest standards of service.

Privacy Policy

Who we are

Aldridge & Pryce Solicitors LLP is authorised and regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA No. 648291). Our registered office is 12 St Peter's Square, Manchester M2 3DF. For data protection purposes, we are the data controller.

What data we collect

When you contact us or instruct us, we may collect:

  • Your name, address, email address, and telephone number
  • Information relating to your legal matter
  • Financial information for billing and transaction completion
  • Identification documents for anti-money laundering compliance

How we use your data

  • Provide legal services and advice
  • Communicate with you about your matter
  • Comply with our regulatory and legal obligations
  • Process payments and manage our accounts

Legal basis

We process data on the basis of: (a) contractual necessity; (b) legal obligation — SRA regulations and anti-money laundering legislation; and (c) legitimate interest — to manage and improve our services.

Data retention

We retain client files for a minimum of six years after the conclusion of a matter, in line with SRA guidelines. Some data may be retained longer where required by law.

Your rights

Under the UK GDPR, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate data
  • Request erasure (subject to legal obligations)
  • Object to or restrict processing in certain circumstances
  • Lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office

Contact us at enquiries@aldridgepryce.co.uk to exercise these rights.

Cookies

This website does not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics.

Complaints Procedure

We are committed to providing a high-quality service. If you are unhappy, please raise your concerns with your solicitor or our Practice Manager, Rachel Cooper (enquiries@aldridgepryce.co.uk, 0161 483 7200).

  1. We acknowledge your complaint within two working days.
  2. Written response within 14 working days.
  3. If unsatisfied, we arrange a meeting or call to discuss further.
  4. Final position in writing within five working days.

Legal Ombudsman

If unresolved, you may refer to the Legal Ombudsman within six months of our final response:

Website www.legalombudsman.org.uk
Telephone 0300 555 0333
Email enquiries@legalombudsman.org.uk
Address PO Box 6167, Slough SL1 0EH

Regulatory Information

Aldridge & Pryce Solicitors LLP is authorised and regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA Number: 648291). Verify on the SRA website.

We comply with the Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds Regulations 2017 and may need to verify your identity before acting for you.
